notes.title: Nazar Wins "Best Interactive Movie" at the British Film Festival
notes.notes:
We are proud to share that Nazar has been awarded "Best Interactive Movie" at the prestigious British Film Festival! 🎉🧿

Set in the mystical landscapes of Cappadocia, Nazar blends FMV interactive cinema with 2D platforming, weaving a gripping story of astrology, divination, and quantum mechanics. Step into the shoes of Nazar as you use parapsychological abilities to uncover secrets and prevent a sinister future.

If you’re a fan of immersive storytelling, interactive films, and cinematic experiences, Nazar is a journey you won’t want to miss. Dive into the mystery and experience the award-winning adventure today! ✨

notes.notes:
New features
Zener assistant
Zener assistant will be activated 20% of the time when you try to guess Zener cards.

Pause menu added to platform puzzles.

New sound effects to enhance the experience in platform puzzles.

Bug fixed: Music and sound problems in rare cases. Performance issues
